implementation_strengths: Stable menu-item field is carried by the known-dish upload.
UUID attempts and a unique photo-per-attempt constraint exist.
New contributions default inactive and unpublished with pending review states.
Versioned consent and named client/server receipts exist.
blocking_findings: Upload and idempotent replay do not enforce the attempt's original restaurant/menu-item binding.
Eligible prompt impressions are recorded without qualified-target enforcement.
Public-unverified traffic does not affirmatively exclude staff.
Native picker cancellations and multiple server failure receipts are incomplete.
Receipt upserts can overwrite first occurrence time and outcome.
No implementation completes terminal review and writes verified_comparison_created.
Current/orderable, provenance, and duplicate gate labels overstate their database evidence.
No bounded image and source-rights packet supports independent target qualification.
The v1 grant is display-scoped and must not be represented as broader derivative or model rights.

independent_checks.build: compiled and typechecked; disposable no-secret checkout stopped at page-data collection because Supabase environment variables were intentionally absent
